title: TesseraQL decision tables v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL shared decision documents (decisions/*.yml): named decision tables a route references from its 'decide:' block with 'use:'. Documented in decision-tables.md.

decisions.description: Named decision tables. Each declares its contract (typed inputs and outputs, hit and miss policies) and rows; how a route wires the inputs (params:) stays at the reference.

inputs.description: Typed inputs by name; each row cell constrains one of these.

domain.description: Field domain reference declaring the input's type.

match.description: How row cells compare against this input: eq (default, equality; empty cell = wildcard), between (inclusive range), in (membership in a small fixed set), bool, orgSubtree (the bound org unit is in the cell's subtree; table sources only, resolved through the managed org closure).

outputs.description: Typed outputs by name; every row sets all of them.

domain.description: Field domain reference declaring the output's type.

enum.description: The output's full value space, enabling consumption-side exhaustiveness lints.

hitPolicy.description: first (default): authored order resolves. unique: more than one conditional match is an error, and overlapping rows fail the build.

onMiss.description: error (default): a lookup no row matches raises TQL-DECISION-4721. default: the trailing row without when: answers.

source.description: The app-owned table carrying the rows (exactly one of rows:/source:): business users maintain them at runtime, and the decision evaluates as one generated SELECT in the operation's transaction. A NULL cell in any mapped column is the wildcard.

id.description: The rule table's key column joining set: child tables. Default id.

match.description: Column realization per input (all but in): exactly one shape per entry.

eq.description: One nullable column for an eq/bool input.

between.description: The nullable [min, max] column pair of a between input.

subtree.description: The nullable unit-id column of an orgSubtree input, matched through the managed org closure.

set.description: Child-table realization of each in input: no child rows = wildcard, membership otherwise.

key.description: The child column referencing the rule row's id.

value.description: The child column carrying one member per row.

priority.description: The resolution-order column; required for hitPolicy: first.

effective.description: Optional dated-row window: the [from, to] column pair matched against the reference's effectiveAt: (default audit.now).

default.description: The outputs answering a miss of a table-backed decision. A YAML-backed decision declares its default as a trailing row without when: instead.

rows.description: The authored rows, resolved in order. A row is the conjunction of its when: cells (absent cell = wildcard); a trailing row without when: is the default.

when.description: Cells by input name: a scalar (eq/bool), a range ('>= 10000', '5..10', a number), or a list (in).

out.description: The outputs this row sets — exactly the declared outputs.
